subject: Re: PT follow-up — validation artifacts & compensating controls
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: penetration test remediation evidence request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the penetration test fixes. Our security team is preparing the remediation evidence package for our SIG/SOC2 review and asked for concrete artifacts to close a couple of findings (high/medium severity items). Specifically we need:

- Proof that the vulnerable endpoint was patched/removed (screenshot of deployment or nginx config, or diff showing removal)
- The ticket(s) where the fix was implemented (exported ticket or link + status)
- Any compensating controls applied (WAF rule ids, IP deny lists, temporary rate-limits)
- Evidence of detection/monitoring changes (log snapshot, alert rule ids, retention policy update)

Could you provide the artifacts or a timeline when we can expect them? Ideally we want timestamped screenshots/configs and the JIRA ticket export. If you prefer, we can take a short walkthrough call.

Appreciate it — we need these for the audit pack due next week.

-Lena
Security Engineering, Acme Corp
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: penetration test remediation evidence request

Team — forwarding Acme's ask. Can you assemble a customer-ready packet with artifacts and a short mapping doc that ties each Acme finding to the evidence? Things to include: 

- JIRA tickets (exported PDF) for the remediation work (include INF- numbers)
- Timestamped screenshots of the deployment/UI showing the fix applied (k8s rollout history / kubectl apply output)
- Config diffs (nginx/k8s manifests) and the git commit that applied the change
- WAF rules applied (rule id and a screenshot from the WAF console) and confirmation of propagation across regions
- ELK/CloudWatch snapshot showing logs after the fix and any alert rules created
- Short note about compensating controls if any partial mitigation remains (e.g., rate-limits, IP blocks)

Rishi — can you own compilation? Monica — can you confirm the SOC2 control owner text we should include? I want to get this back to them by Thursday EOD PST.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of GTM Security (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up: penetration test remediation evidence request

Vivek / Monica — attaching a draft packet for review before we send to Acme. Artifacts attached here (zipped for transit): pt-fix-screenshots.zip (contains nginx conf screenshot, k8s rollout history pngs), INF-4821-ticket-export.pdf, deployment-apply-diff.txt, waf-rule-screenshot.png, elk-log-snapshot.png.

Quick mapping:
- Finding ACME-PT-2026-01 (insecure endpoint): fixed via commit 9b7c3a on 2026-05-04; see deployment-apply-diff.txt and k8s-rollout-20260504.png inside the zip. JIRA INF-4821 documents the remediation and code review.
- Finding ACME-PT-2026-03 (rate-limit bypass): temporary rate-limit and WAF rule RL-207 applied 2026-05-05 (waf-rule-screenshot.png). Full mitigation to be merged in feature branch; ticket INF-4825.
- Detection/logging: ELK snapshot shows post-fix traffic flows and the new alert rule (Alert ID: ELK-912). Retention policy updated — log-retention-policy-v2 applied 2026-05-06 (see elk-log-snapshot.png).

Compensating controls summary (to include in the packet):
- WAF rule RL-207 with IP deny list for known malicious ranges (propagated to us-east/us-west-eu)
- Temporary rate-limits applied at the ingress LB (config change documented in INF-4825)
- Increased logging and alerting (ELK-912) with 90-day retention for relevant indices
- SOC2 control owner statement: Monica to provide signed control owner line.

I also uploaded a drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink and added the ticket exports. If this looks good I can send to Acme with a short cover letter and a validation checklist they can use.

-Rishi
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmecorp.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PT follow-up — validation artifacts & compensating controls

Hi Lena,

Thanks for the patience — please find the remediation evidence packet attached and a short mapping of artifacts to your findings. Summary below and attachments are included for audit ingestion.

Summary (high level):
- Finding ACME-PT-2026-01: Endpoint removed from public load balancer and replaced with internal-only k8s service. Evidence: k8s rollout history screenshot (k8s-rollout-20260504.png) + deployment diff (deployment-apply-diff.txt). JIRA: INF-4821 (export attached as INF-4821-ticket-export.pdf).
- Finding ACME-PT-2026-03: Rate-limit bypass mitigated with temporary ingress rate-limits + WAF rule RL-207 applied (waf-rule-screenshot.png). Full code fix scheduled; ticket INF-4825 tracking completion.
- Detection/Monitoring: ELK snapshot included showing post-fix logs and the alert rule ELK-912; retention policy updated to 90 days for impacted indices (elk-log-snapshot.png).

Attachments: pt-fix-screenshots.zip (contains UI and config screenshots), INF-4821-ticket-export.pdf, deployment-apply-diff.txt, waf-rule-screenshot.png, elk-log-snapshot.png.

We also included a short compensating controls note signed by our security team and Monica will add the SOC2 control owner statement. If you'd like, Rishi can walk your team through the artifacts on a 30-minute call — suggested times Friday 10am or Monday 11am PST.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts meet your audit requirements or if you need additional timestamped server-level logs or region-by-region confirmations.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM Security (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmecorp.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PT follow-up — validation artifacts & compensating controls

Vivek / Rishi — received, thank you. The packet looks comprehensive and the mapping is helpful. A couple of follow-ups before we can close the findings: 

1) Can you provide a timestamped server-side audit (sysconfig or /var/log/secure excerpt) showing the deployment event for ACME-PT-2026-01? The screenshots are good but the auditor wants evidence pulled from the host or deployment pipeline showing the exact timestamp.
2) For the WAF rule RL-207, please confirm propagation to eu-west-1 and provide the WAF console export for that region (or a screenshot with region selector visible).

If you can provide those two items by Monday EOD PST we'll mark the items as resolved in our tracker. Otherwise we can schedule the walkthrough and have Rishi show the live evidence.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick response.

-Lena
Security Engineering, Acme Corp
